karen: Heads up — perf regression in the kernel selector/autotuner. On H100, causal model, seqlen=4096, head_dim=48 the selector picked SDPA v3 but v3 is ~1.8x slower than v1 for this case. Repro + traces below.

mike: Can you paste the repro command/config?

karen: Ran perf-bench microbench (batch=1, heads=32, head_dim=48 -> hidden=1536). Quick nvprof excerpt: 
```
SDPA v3:  kernel_sdpa_v3  1.21ms  (hot)
SDPA v1:  kernel_sdpa_v1  0.67ms  (hot)
Total tokens/sec: v3=12k, v1=21k
Notes: v3 shows higher shared mem stalls and lower vector throughput on H100 for this specific head dim.
```

sanjay: Interesting — v3 paths assumed head_dim aligned to 64/128 for vectorized lanes. 48 isn't aligned so the vectorized codegen ends up with scalar fallbacks. Does the autotuner consider alignment and causal vs non-causal?

karen: Not for causal. Our autotuner suite only ran the non-causal microbench for v3, so causal-specific memory access pattern wasn't measured. Also saw that KV cache concat/pad in the runtime increases effective seqlen (padding to 64) which changes memory layout before kernel pick.

olivia: That padding detail matters — we accidentally pick v3 based on raw seqlen but the kernel sees padded shapes after KV merging. For causal v3 we also trigger an extra prefix scan branch which is heavier at small head_dim.

mike: Proposal: two-prong fix: (1) make selector architecture-aware (A100/H100) + alignment-aware (head_dim % 64 check) and (2) add a causal microbench variant to autotuner so we measure the exact path the runtime will take. Quick heuristic: prefer v1/v2 when head_dim % 64 != 0 and head_dim <= 64 for causal models.

sanjay: I prefer a cost-model rather than brittle heuristics. Example: compute vector_eff = head_dim / round_up(head_dim, 64). If vector_eff < 0.8 assume vectorization loss and bias toward v1. Also include an estimate of extra memory passes for causal kernels (multiply cost by 1.2). We can tune thresholds from perf benchmarks.

karen: I pushed a local branch with NVTX markers around the SDPA branches and a small perf-bench script that runs causal microbench across seqlen=[512,1024,2048,4096,8192] and head_dim=[32,48,64,96,128]. I'll add the output to the PR.

perf-ci-bot: queued perf run for branch karen/sdpa-head48 — results expected in ~2h.

olivia: Also adding a unit test to simulate KV cache concat padding so selector uses the post-pad shape during decision. That should prevent the mismatch between selection and executed kernel.

sanjay: I'll own the selector change (cost-model + arch gating). @olivia please add the causal microbench harness to autotuner; @karen please add the perf CI job and NVTX markers. We'll hold a short review after CI results.

karen: If perf CI fails I'll temporarily disable autotune for causal flows where head_dim <= 48 to avoid regressions in release. :crossed_fingers: Please ping in thread when jobs finish.
